summary: Inventory web application is running on node2 and node3 at port 8080. Node1 load-balances HTTP traffic across both backends at port 80. All nodes passed serial reboot-persistence and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Installed nginx on all three Alpine nodes and enabled it in the default OpenRC runlevel.
Deployed identical inventory application data on node2 and node3 with backend identity headers and health endpoints.
Configured node1 with both backends using nginx round-robin load balancing.
Verified direct backend health, proxied application content, and alternating requests across node2 and node3.
Rebooted exactly one node at a time and confirmed changed boot identities, service recovery, persisted data, and restored backend availability.
Confirmed node1 continued serving through the remaining backend while each application node restarted.

evidence.requirement: Inventory application on node2:8080 and node3:8080
evidence.summary: Both direct endpoints returned healthy backend identities and Inventory Web Application content.

evidence.requirement: Load balancing on node1:80 across both backends
evidence.summary: Node1 returned healthy status and the final request sequence alternated between node3 and node2 while serving the application.
